==Description==
The '''Hidden Zoomer''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared during the [[Area 51 Event]]. It was slightly faster than the [[Zoomer]] and had more health than it.

Despite its name suggested that it was hidden, towers without hidden detection could still target the '''Hidden Zoomer'''.

==Appearance==
The '''Hidden Zoomer''' had grey skin, a grey fabric torso, black fabric legs and black wristbands. It had no eyes and wore a black headband. Its running animation was similar to the Naruto run. The '''Hidden Zoomer''' was very similar to the [[Zoomer]] in many regards.

==Strategy==
*Despite the fact that it is called the '''Hidden Zoomer''', it is not actually hidden.
*The [[Freezer]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow the '''Hidden Zoomer''' down.
*Fast firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], are very effective against '''Hidden Zoomers''', while slow firing towers, such as the [[Sniper]], struggle against it.
*You can also use the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] to damage groups of '''Hidden Zoomers''', though you may need a [[Commander]] to boost their firerate.

==Trivia==
*The '''Hidden Zoomer''' was not actually hidden and could be attacked by any tower. 
**Therefore, the first hidden event [[Enemies|enemy]] was the [[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|Ghost]].
*The '''Hidden Zoomer''' was based on the character of [[wp:Naruto|Naruto]].
**This itself is based on the ''Storm Area 51, They Can't Stop All of Us'' Facebook event which said: "''If we naruto run{{sic}}, we can move faster than their bullets.''"
**The running animation is the Naruto run, another reference of Naruto.
**The '''Hidden Zoomer''' uses the {{RLinkC|11297708|Black Ninja Headband of the Silent Sun}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The '''Hidden Zoomer''' is a reference to a nickname for Generation Z.
**The '''Hidden Zoomer''' being based off ''Naruto'' is a stereotype that younger people are fonder of anime.
